name: The Mills at Jersey Gardens
summary: The Mills at Jersey Gardens is New Jersey's largest outlet shopping destination, featuring over 200 outlet stores including Saks OFF 5TH, Neiman Marcus Last Call, and dozens of popular brands offering significant discounts. Located near Newark Airport in Elizabeth, the center combines tax-free shopping with entertainment options including a cinema complex, making it a premier destination for value-conscious shoppers.
demographics: The Mills at Jersey Gardens attracts a diverse, value-conscious shopper base primarily from the New York-New Jersey metropolitan area, with a strong representation of middle-income families and bargain hunters seeking designer brands at outlet prices. The trade area draws heavily from urban and suburban communities within a 30-mile radius, including significant populations from Newark, Jersey City, and Staten Island, with visitors ranging from young professionals to families with children. The center appeals particularly to tourists and international shoppers visiting the New York area who are drawn to tax-free shopping in New Jersey combined with outlet pricing. Shopping patterns reflect a destination-oriented visit with longer dwell times as customers seek deals across multiple stores, with peak traffic on weekends and holidays.
description: The Mills at Jersey Gardens stands as New Jersey's largest outlet and value retail destination, offering an unparalleled shopping experience with over 200 outlet stores spanning major brands and designer labels. Located just minutes from Newark Liberty International Airport in Elizabeth, New Jersey, this enclosed super-regional outlet center has become a premier shopping destination for both local residents and international tourists seeking exceptional value. The center features an impressive roster of high-end outlet retailers including Saks OFF 5TH and Neiman Marcus Last Call, alongside popular brands like Nike, Coach, Michael Kors, and dozens of other sought-after names, all offering significant discounts off regular retail prices. Beyond shopping, the Mills at Jersey Gardens provides a complete entertainment experience with a state-of-the-art cinema complex and diverse dining options ranging from quick-service restaurants to sit-down eateries. With its strategic location near major highways and public transportation, combined with New Jersey's tax-free shopping on clothing and footwear, the center has established itself as a must-visit destination that attracts millions of visitors annually seeking both value and variety in an enclosed, climate-controlled environment.
